title: Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.0: perf profiles, metadata and changelog automation
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Add aurora-spark-13b v1.0 metadata and performance profiles. Implement changelog automation to generate release notes and model registry entries during onboarding. No breaking changes.
description: Context: Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.0 into the model registry with curated performance profiles and standardized metadata. Motivation: Aurora-spark is a high-throughput 13B variant optimized for streaming workloads; we need validated performance profiles and automated changelog entries so downstream teams can rely on published latency/cost numbers and release notes. What this PR does: - Add model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, quantization recommendations, known limitations) under models/aurora-spark-13b/v1.0/metadata.yaml. - Add performance profiles (throughput/latency by sequence length and hardware) under perf_profiles/aurora-spark-13b-v1.0.json. - Extend the changelog automation tooling (scripts/changelog_automation.py) to detect model onboarding commits and generate a standardized release note entry in CHANGELOG_MODELS.md. - Update onboarding unit and integration tests (tests/test_model_onboard.py) and add a small perf validation harness used in CI. - Add docs snippet to redwood-model-registry/README.md that explains metadata fields and perf profile interpretation. Checklist: - [x] Metadata file added and schema validated - [x] Perf profiles generated from benchmark lab outputs and sanity-checked - [x] Changelog automation updated and tested locally - [x] Unit + integration tests added and passing in CI - [x] Docs updated for consumers Usage notes: The perf profiles include profiles for g4dn.12xlarge (fp16), p3.8xlarge (fp32), and a quantized int8 path for dedicated deployments. The changelog automation will create a draft entry under CHANGELOG_MODELS.md and attach model metadata link; CI will fail on schema mismatch. Follow-ups: - Add explicit region/instance mapping in the registry (ENG-4902) - Wire automated perf validation into nightly perf-canary (ENG-4950)
